_readme: Weapons and armor (from the Equipment Stats tab of the design sheet). A unit's stats = (level stats + Body + every piece's base stats x its quality's baseMultiplier) x every piece's modifiers. Modifiers multiply (1.2 = 120%; missing = 100%), except pPenPct / mPenPct, which add whole percents of penetration. Weapon skills: the first is the basic attack, the second the class skill; range is the weapon's range in tiles (its Basic Attack's, and the bow's shots). art is the pose and weapon drawn on figures, outfit the armor drawn (src/art/unitArt.js). builtIn entries are what a unit has with nothing equipped (Unarmed, No Armor): they aren't items.

smithy._comment: The Smithy (Outer City): buys Common gear on the spot (buyQuality), and takes orders for better quality, paid up front: each quality in orderDays takes that many days of work. It works on up to workers orders at a time; the rest wait in the queue. Prices are the qualities' values.

enemyGear._comment: Enemies whose gear quality is crude get Common gear instead with this chance per level (0.03 = 3% per level, so 30% at level 10).

adventurerGear._comment: Adventurers at the guild hall come with Crude gear; each piece (weapon and armor) is Common instead with this chance per level (0.03 = 3% per level, so 30% at level 10).

greatsword.name: Greatsword
greatsword.description: A heavy two-handed blade: hits harder than a spear, but only reaches the enemies next to you.

spear.name: Spear
spear.description: Reach weapon: strikes from 2 tiles away, trading some of the greatsword's power for range.

sword_shield.name: Sword and Shield
sword_shield.description: A balanced frontline weapon: full physical power behind the shield's Defense.

mace_shield.name: Mace and Shield
mace_shield.description: The mace crushes through armor (50% P.Pen) for less raw power; the shield adds Defense.

dagger.name: Single Dagger
dagger.description: A quick blade that slips past armor, and leaves the other hand free for spellcasting (no M.Atk penalty).

twin_daggers.name: Twin Daggers
twin_daggers.description: A blade in each hand that slips past armor: full physical power, but weaker magic.

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.description:
Light and compact, suitable for scouts: shorter range, but you move faster.
Same modes as the Longbow (Direct, Indirect, Melee).

longbow.name: Longbow
longbow.description:
The longest reach of any weapon, without the shortbow's speed. Three modes:
• Direct: 100% P.Atk, weapon range
• Indirect: 70% P.Atk, 1.5x range,
   arcs over cover
• Melee: 80% P.Atk, 1.5 tiles
Switch Mode is a free action.

crystal.name: Crystal
crystal.description: Focuses energy for destructive power: its magic cuts through Defense (50% M.Pen), but it's weak up close.

staff.name: Staff
staff.description: Amplifies magic for both offense and support: the most M.Atk for damage and healing, with a 2-tile reach.

unarmed.name: Unarmed
unarmed.description: Fists. What you fight with without a weapon.

leather.name: Leather
leather.description: Light armor. Provides protection with little compromise.

mail.name: Mail
mail.description: Medium armor. Better protection, but slows you down a little.

plate.name: Plate
plate.description: Heavy Armor. The most protective, and the most cumbersome.

none.name: No Armor
none.description: No Armor. Not recommended for an adventurer.
